title: Customer feedback expands versatility of Grove’s Wire Rope Cleaner
summary: The Wire Rope Cleaner automates cleaning and lubrication for wire ropes on mobile cranes.Updates to the product mean it can now be used on a wider range of ropes covering any brand of crane.
body_markdown:
Originally, the Wire Rope Cleaner was developed to match the wire rope diameters of Grove mobile cranes. As adoption grew, customers began asking whether the system could be used on ropes of different diameters and on cranes beyond those from Grove. Following a product redesign, the Wire Rope Cleaner can now accommodate ropes from 12 mm to 38 mm diameter on any crane brand, with any rope lay. That means greater versatility for customers and the opportunity to simplify rope maintenance across the fleet.


The updated Wire Rope Cleaner demonstrates how Manitowoc’s Voice of the Customer process extends beyond issue resolution to uncover opportunities for continuous product improvement. It’s about offering a full suite of solutions that enhance productivity over a crane’s lifecycle, and using real-world feedback so owners benefit from reduced downtime and higher return on investment.


“Keeping a wire rope clean may not seem the highest profile part of crane ownership, but it has a very real impact on uptime and operating costs. Because a crane without a rope has no use. Through our Voice of the Customer process, we’ve made a successful maintenance tool even more versatile. It’s a practical example of CRANES+50 delivering greater value to customers across the crane lifecycle,” said Astrid Hager-Guthrie.
